answer: Settle on the lowest offer, never the average, and extra names can only undercut their maker. Averaging quotes is a relic of markets where every seller was a person. Here a buyer agent pays the single cheapest quote for a translation. A tide of fake quotes priced high to mimic scarcity moves nothing. Priced low, it sets a nadir the attacker is then bound to work for, so his flood buys him a loss-making job.
